steps.en: Explicitly select the small English ONNX model
steps.zh: 显式选择小型英文 ONNX 模型

steps.en: Fetch the model and voice arrays and initialize the inference graph
steps.zh: 获取模型与音色数组，初始化推理图

steps.en: Provide English text and the Bruno voice
steps.zh: 提供英文文字和 Bruno 音色

steps.en: Convert English pronunciation into 24 kHz speech samples
steps.zh: 把英文读音转换成 24 kHz 语音采样

steps.en: Save the speech as a WAV file
steps.zh: 将语音保存为 WAV 文件

value.en: Local English speech from a small model without operating a GPU service
value.zh: 用小模型获得本地英文语音，不必维护显卡服务
